extract_level_number: extract a level number from a file path string using regex pattern matching
extract_record_number: extract a record number from a directory name string using regex pattern matching
find_levels_in_configs: walk a directory tree and parse config.yaml files to extract level numbers and record info
find_levels_in_configs_glob: parse config.yaml files matching glob patterns to extract experiment metadata including model, runner, and ideator
filter_folder_info: filter a folder info dictionary by key-value conditions to find matching experiment configurations
